$Comment: The library's sample trainer, switched off: an NPC placement with a Trainer block, so the character it stands is a trainer and its page shows the whole loop on a server running the library alone. Turn it on in mods/ziggfreedcommon/npc-placements.json with { "Zc_Trainer_Example": { "Enabled": true } }, together with the sample track (tracks.json) and its two lessons (track-picks.json, Zc_Track_Example_Trainer_Footwork and Zc_Track_Example_Trainer_Guard). It stands three and a half blocks from the spawn point of the world named default, never in an instance. Press F opens its conversation, whose Train answer opens the page: Learn lists every pick whose Where names this placement, Quests the quests this character gives, and Services a respec of the sample track at that track's own price. Tracks names the climbs it serves (Categories names whole categories), and Sections lays the page out; leave Sections out to show every part. Switch this placement off again and its lessons are learned on the sample track's own page.
Name: Zc_Trainer_Example
